mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate rise exceeding 0.2 percentage points indicates labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust consumer and business confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days through improved earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST are above 12-month MA, or Rank IC for interaction < 0.02 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY) triggers expectations of monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in housing starts below 850.0 thousand units signals weak demand, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST falls below 850.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Positive employment growth (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth is positive, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a supply shock, reducing corporate margins and increasing uncertainty, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2% in 3 months, or Rank IC for interaction < 0.02 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 2.5% annualized) leads to overvaluation and impending rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 2.5% annualized, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
